summary: The guide page strictly complies with the assigned plan, boundaries, word count target, and evidence base. Primary source citations from the ISO/IAF Auditing Practices Group guidance on reviewing and closing nonconformities and NIST RPD-G-08 are accurately contextualized with required auditor guidance and laboratory scope disclaimers. Each subsection covers workflow roles, inputs, decision gates, records, exceptions, evaluation criteria for software demonstrations, and consistently labeled hypothetical illustrative examples featuring the unnamed machining manufacturer. No unassigned FAQ section is present.

glossary.definition: Follow-up evidence check that a corrective action prevented recurrence before closure.
Action to eliminate the cause of a nonconformity and prevent recurrence.
Immediate steps that limit the effect of a finding while its cause is investigated.
Non-fulfillment of a requirement (ISO 9000 as cited in the APG paper).
The role responsible for decisions and records in the defined workflow.
A workflow permission rule preventing the person who implements a corrective action from approving or verifying its effectiveness.
The ability to reconstruct the complete chronological history of a finding, including containment, cause, actions, approvals, and effectiveness evidence.

decisions: Define effectiveness criteria (measure, scope, duration) linked to accepted cause
Schedule follow-up review date upon plan approval
Select follow-up evidence method (on-site observation vs remote documentary review)
Evaluate process side effects created by the corrective action
Extend monitoring period or accept result with caveat based on sample limits
Mark effectiveness check as failed and reopen finding instead of creating an unlinked record
Recheck and reapply containment upon effectiveness failure
Return to cause analysis and replan corrective actions upon recurrence
Escalate recurring failures to management after reaching defined cycle threshold
Verify closure preconditions across containment, cause, actions, and effectiveness
Authorize final closure by an independent role separate from the action owner
Authorize override of separation of duties with documented justification
